【我比老鼠还老鼠】不可思议迷宫类的回合制冒险RPG，但实际玩下来其实比较像回合制潜行，因为游戏的目的是扮演矮人挖到更多的矿来升级自己的装备，所以避开战斗、专心挖矿才是最高效的。流程很短，一个多小时就能全成就了，全程体验很有小巧思，大家都能在肝到烦之前就完成游戏。初期绕着老鼠偷摸打洞的体验属实比老鼠还老鼠，搭配这个新奇的不可思议迷宫+潜行挖矿的创意食用，出乎意料的很好玩，难怪虽然冷门却有着100%的好评。 虽然没有中文，但文本量很低，关键信息都是阿拉伯数字和图案，比如知道谁掉了多少血，还需要挖多少个啥矿的，都能玩。主菜单从上往下数第一个按钮开新一局游戏，第二个按钮打造（其实是升级）装备，一旦升级了就永久解锁成为初始装备。 定价贵了，2刀的内容量。 难度挺低的，总结了几个小技巧，可以无伤无限探索，可惜游戏的目的是挖矿升级装备，而不是探索更多的空间（虽然相辅相成）： 0、特别注意事项：游戏没有暂停菜单，一旦按esc就是退出本局游戏回到主菜单了，别问我是怎么知道的。建议进图之前截图craft界面，以便随时查看自己挖够矿没。矿镐是一定要尽快升级的，攻击力决定了挖矿速度，初始矿镐挖中级矿——铁得敲10下，挖墙都得5下一块，升级以后速度倍增。没有防御力数值，升级体系只有攻击力（矿镐）和血量（防具）。没有回血道具，没有任何道具和技能可以捡，只有敌人、矿和墙，但是每到新一层，血量自动回满。只能往下走不能往上走，死亡无惩罚，只是再开新一局，都会从最高层重开。长按左键可以连续挥镐。 1、虽然火把只能照亮一小圈，但其实那个阴影是半透明的，完全可以看清整个屏幕的矿物、怪物和路线分布。 2、如果主打效率走潜行路线，就需要避开“每个区域的怪可以行走的边缘格子，以及每个边缘格子的周围8格”——初期不打通，怪就打不到你，而出于开发者简单粗暴的设计，每个怪都可以溅射周围8格。不过这里也有一个小小的技巧，周围的斜角4格其实是可以挖的，只是不能走而已，走过就会被打，那如果斜角4格有想要的矿物，直接站在背后一格挖过去，自己别走就行。 3、很重要：下楼的楼梯口一定在地图的左半区！亲测，一定，100%！虽然本作地图是完全随机的，所以存在随到倒霉地图被开门鲨的可能性（或者天胡完美潜行分布），但作者不知道处于什么心理，只把楼梯口放到左半区了，所以每一层都往左挖，探索左半区，是最高效的。 4、负3楼开始有铁，负5楼开始出现后期稀有矿物且随着下楼概率递增（不排除极端情况下4楼就有的可能性，并且5楼也存在完全不出的可能性）。 5、负5或者负6楼开始出现可以破坏（蠕虫与后期的巨型蠕虫）与无视（幽灵）地形的怪，需要提前戒备，这种逃不掉的，打就完事了。所以这个时期开始，一边挖一边要留意四周动静，别回头被偷剩血丝了才反应过来。 6、全成就比通关快，成就只需要挖过所有类型矿+打过所有类型怪就行，并不要求下负10楼。我是在负7楼解锁了最后一个成就打巨型蠕虫的，不确定极端随机数下它会不会出现在负6楼。注意成就要求的是“巨型”，负5、6楼出现的那种小蠕虫不算数。 7、巨型蠕虫攻高血厚，升级2轮矿镐+防具以后，就算抢到先手也只能做到满血同归于尽，可以解锁成就。如果希望能留在深层挖矿，尽快通关，那就先再升一轮装备吧；如果无所谓，只想全成就，那保证自己满血且先手打巨型蠕虫，就全部完成了。 8、写给不熟悉不可思议迷宫玩法的朋友的战斗小技巧： “等待”回合是非常重要的策略. 因为玩家在动的同时怪也会动，彼此相差双数距离时没有问题；但如果相差单数格子，就会存在谁先手——换言之谁多打一下的问题。 这游戏没有设置专门的等待按钮，并且有一个要命的设计缺陷是：一旦玩家走到跟怪重叠的格子，玩家就会打不到怪，单方面被揍； 而重新调整距离变成面对面，需要走至少2步，从怪溅射周围8格的设计来说，也就是靠送血来换距离； 且万一被怪堆围了，四周没有拉开距离的空间，那就只能下一把见噜。 为了抢到先手，建议先停下来预判敌人的行进路线（怪的路径算法一定是跟随玩家的位置来寻找最短路线的），提前调整好自己的位置，对着敌人即将来到自己身边的那个格子开始空挥武器（矿镐），用空挥来达到“等待回合”的作用。这么做的话，所有可以一招秒的怪就可以靠抢先手来无伤秒了，不需要各自挨一下。 —————————————————— 我从10年前开始接触独立游戏，目前从事独立游戏发行工作已经超过8年。时至今日，或许我们已经无法再清晰定义“到底什么是独立游戏”，但我们永远都可以从独立游戏中寻找到惊喜。目标是把我玩过的几千款独立游戏都装进来，欢迎朋友们来赏玩我眼中的独立游戏世界. 鉴赏家地址： Dungeon Digger is an exciting roguelike where you guide a brave dwarf in search of legendary treasures. Delve deep underground, mine valuable minerals, craft superior gear, and battle foes like spiders, golems, and ghosts. A must-play for adventure and treasure hunting fans!
A fun roguelike with interesting mechanics, perfect for relaxing after work in the evening with a cup of tea.
cool adventure roguelike with ore mining, I really liked the game, calm atmosphere, turn on lofi music and enjoy the gameplay. I recommend everyone to play it

I recently purchased Dungeon Digger and I must say, it exceeded my expectations! The graphics are stunning, and the gameplay is immersive. Exploring the vast dungeons while battling unique monsters kept me hooked for hours. The crafting system is a real highlight, allowing for endless customization. I highly recommend this game to anyone looking for a thrilling adventure!
The bare minimum for what it takes to be called a game.
Meditative game about the adventures of a gnome underground, it is quite pleasant to make your way through the thickness of the soil for the purpose of exploration.

the description of the game certainly looks cool, but in reality there is no development in the mechanics, here are mobs, here is crafting and that's it, as if I am playing different games at the same time
I really enjoyed this game. Maybe some people might find it boring, but damn it's so relaxing, like there's nothing to do and you're just playing and enjoying.
I had high hopes for Dungeon Digger, but it fell flat. The graphics are outdated, and the gameplay gets boring quickly. It lacks depth and innovation. Definitely not worth the investment.

An exciting roguelike RPG where you take on the role of a brave dwarf and explore the depths of an underground kingdom. Your mission is to collect rare minerals to create powerful equipment and battle spiders, golems, worms, and ghosts. The game features a crafting system that allows you to create unique gear. You will also engage in deep exploration and face challenging enemies, making each playthrough unique and full of adventure. Become a dungeon legend by uncovering secrets and hunting for treasures!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38888018-United-Critics/] Please follow [b]United Critics[/b] for quality reviews[/url] [h2]Dungeon Digger Review[/h2] [h1]The Deeper We Go[/h1] Dungeon Digger is the perfect game if you are looking for something cheap, relaxing, and mining for hours on. Dig your way around in this 2D top-down, dwarven digging game. Mine various ores to craft new/better gear and tools or find mineshafts leading deeper down. [h1]The Game of The Play[/h1] In Dungeon Digger, you’re a hard-working mountain dwarf digging deep within the mountain for various ores. And with those ores, upgrade your gear and tools for safer travel and faster digging. The player always begins on the first level and will need to find mineshafts to reach deeper depths of the mine and discover various ores. This means that the better upgrades the player has, the quicker they can dig and return to their last known level or go even deeper. The only way for the player to exit the mines and return to the main menu is by simply pressing the “ESC” button. Or dying by enemies: “All the looted ore will still count as mined and saved.” “From what it seems, there are around ten levels.” In the main menu, the player only has three options: Play – Craft – Exit. No settings tab for audio or display, so if the player feels like the music is too loud, they’d need to lower the game's volume from Windows audio settings. [b]Crafting/Upgrading[/b] In the main menu there is a tab called “Crafting.” In that tab, the player will see two bars, each filled with icons of different ores. Those tabs show what ores and how much of each ore is needed for the next upgrade of the player's gear or tool. [h1]Visual & Audio[/h1] [b]Visuals[/b] Other than being a classical pixel 2D game, the animations for this game are so cute, fun, and interesting. And it’s not all the animations; it's specifically the dwarfs mining animation. As it's not only his pickaxe that swings, but his eyes and facial/bodily expression change with the swinging of the pickaxe, which I find a liking to. Sometimes it’s the smallest things that make the best of it all. [b]Audio[/b] Even though there are no settings for the audio, the game consists of this pleasant tavern background music, which is very soothing and fits the whole theme. [h1]Pros and Cons[/h1] [List][b]Pros[/b] [*]Pleasent Music [*]Stunning Character Animations [*]Cheap [b]Cons[/b] [*]No Audio Settings[/List] [h1]My final little thoughts[/h1] This enjoyable little game is cheap, fun, takes some time mining, and of course soothing tavern music to accompany you on the ride. I recommend this game for anyone who’s looking for a cheap, fun, small game. Rating: 9/10 To Be a Dwarf

Gotta give this one a thumbs down at this point. I've only putzed with it for a little while, but it has nothing to say for itself. You play as a weird looking naked chicken I think? Actually I think it is supposed to be a dwarf, but you'd never guess it. You work your way around a map, digging from a top down perspective, hunting for ore. So far I have found a ton of gold and a bunch of gold, but you can't do anything with it. Apparently I need one of six different ores to upgrade anything, but I've only found the two. I've also found a bunch of rats, that kill me pretty quickly. Oddly I also found that you can die simply by working your way off the edge of the map, but there is no warning, so be careful. There is no town, my character has no name, there is no story, and really nothing so far to recommend this game. There are no settings, and I don't even know if I have found all the commands. The store blurb implies character leveling, I think, but I see no sign of that either. I think the developers know this is a horrible offering, as I got it when it was forty nine cents, and now they are charging forty dollars, maybe to hide their shame? I feel the need to putz around a bit more, maybe find something else to it, but as is, it's a big two thumbs down, avoid at any price.
I don't really like this bagel. It's too monotonous and unpretentious (even if the genre is based on constant replays), but at least it's worth a penny.

Dungeon Digger — это игра, которая обещает многое, но, к сожалению, не оправдывает ожиданий. Во-первых, управление оставляет желать лучшего: гном двигается неестественно, а взаимодействие с предметами часто приводит к ошибкам. Графика выглядит устаревшей, даже для жанра roguelike, и это сильно отвлекает от игрового процесса. Баланс сложности тоже огорчает: первые уровни слишком простые, но уже через пару этапов сложность резко возрастает, что делает игру несправедливо сложной. Добавьте к этому однообразный геймплей, где приходится делать одно и то же снова и снова, и становится понятно, что Dungeon Digger быстро надоедает. Если вы ищете качественный roguelike, лучше поискать что-то другое.‍

《Dungeon Digger》是一款Roguelike冒险游戏，游戏以矮人寻找传说中的宝藏为背景，玩家需要深入地下王国，开采矿物、制作装备，并与各种敌人战斗，最终成为洞穴英雄。 玩家需要操控角色在地牢中挖掘方块，收集宝石和其他有价值的资源，并利用这些资源制作和升级装备。游戏中有多种敌人，包括蜘蛛、石像、蠕虫和幽灵，每个敌人都有独特的攻击方式。此外，游戏还设有深度探索机制，玩家可以进入地下王国的更深层，发现隐藏的宝藏和稀有矿物。 游戏采用Roguelike机制，每次进入地牢的布局和事件都会有所不同，虽然游戏目前提供了丰富的探索内容，但后续内容的扩展性仍有待提升。 如果你喜欢地牢探险和Roguelike游戏，那么《Dungeon Digger》绝对值得一试。
Great game! Engaging story, beautiful graphics, and smooth controls. Spent several hours playing and didn’t even notice the time flying by. Highly recommended for fans of the genre!

[b]Oh, I love these types of games.[/b] I've been playing Beetle Ju, Terraria, and SteamWorld since I was a kid. That's why I love 2D mining simulators. And this game caught my attention. There won't be a rich plot or deep lore. It'll be a simple pixel game where we'll mine ores and fight spiders. But that's more than enough. It's a great way to spend an evening not in intense battles, but just walking around a cave, collecting gems and ores. If you want to relax, grab your pickaxe and go mining. Dungeon Digger is a strategy game where you build dungeons and set traps. The game offers many interesting features, and the animation of the pickaxe is a real masterpiece. Everything works flawlessly, allowing you to enjoy the gameplay for several hours.
short but sweet digging game just dig get minerals upgrade your armor and pickaxe get deeper and repeat easy to get the achivements in a 1hour or two
You'll need to exercise patience at this low cost but adorable mining game. Although mining will begin slowly, with time and work, you will be able to go to deeper levels and obtain better equipment.
Easy roguelike with self-explanatory achievements. Focus on finding the exit as soon as possible. ~1 hour to 100%.
